name: Vampire - Bite (Costs 2 Actions) - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a legendary

results.text: The target writhes free at the last second, leaving only a shallow graze on their collarbone.
A flash of steel intercepts the vampire's strike, sending his fangs clashing against cold iron.
The prey's desperate cry shatters the night, causing the undead lord to hesitate mid-bite.
His jaws snap shut on empty air as his quarry vanishes into shadowy mist.
A sudden gust of wind carries the scent of burning garlic, forcing the vampire back with a snarl.
